title: Use System API action “Cancel Close Out” to cancel closeout exchanges not in progress
summary: Use the System API action “Cancel Close Out” to cancel closeout exchanges that are not currently in progress. The source ties this to scenarios such as a manual bag out, where the system is back up and you want to cancel exchanges that were marked for exchange but are not actively in progress.
when_to_use: Use when the customer has performed a manual bag out and the system is back up/running, and you need to cancel closeout exchanges that are not in progress.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the System API action “Cancel Close Out” via the System API interface (e.g., API Dog) and confirm the cancellation scope matches “not in progress.”
access_or_tools_needed: System API interface that exposes the “Cancel Close Out” action (source mentions API Dog usage for API calls).

access_required: Access to the System API interface that provides the “Cancel Close Out” action (API Dog / API surface).
system_preconditions: Closeout exchanges exist that are expected to be in a state of “not in progress” (so they are eligible for cancellation per the source rule).
